tool_schemas.name: getNews
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of the latest published crypto news flashes (short-form items) normalized by the News Feed Server, filtered by optional language, topic (id or slug), source, and published_at range, and sorted by the requested order; results are limited by `limit` and can be continued by passing the returned `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is out of range, `published_after`/`published_before` are not valid ISO-8601 timestamps (or the range is inconsistent), `topic_id`/`source_id` do not match the required ULID patterns, or `sort`/`language` are not supported. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the feed, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of news flash items to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

topic_id.description: Filter results to items tagged with a specific topic (topics.id ULID).

topic_slug.description: Filter results to items tagged with a specific topic slug.

published_after.description: Only return items published after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

published_before.description: Only return items published before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: getArticles
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of the latest published long-form crypto research articles, filtered by optional language, topic (id or slug), source, and published_at range, and sorted by the requested order; results are limited by `limit` and can be continued by passing the returned `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is out of range, `published_after`/`published_before` are not valid ISO-8601 timestamps (or the range is inconsistent), `topic_id`/`source_id` do not match the required ULID patterns, or `sort`/`language` are not supported. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the feed, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

topic_id.description: Filter results to items tagged with a specific topic (topics.id ULID).

topic_slug.description: Filter results to items tagged with a specific topic slug.

published_after.description: Only return articles published after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

published_before.description: Only return articles published before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: getSources
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of configured ingestion sources, optionally filtered by status and type; results are ordered by `created_at` descending by default and can be continued by passing the returned `cursor`. Refuses invalid filters with VALIDATION_ERROR.

limit.description: Maximum number of sources to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against source name and base_url.

tool_schemas.name: upsertSource
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new source or updates an existing source by `id`. Returns the stored source. Refuses lifecycle transitions that are not allowed and rejects invalid URLs or out-of-range `reliability_score` with VALIDATION_ERROR.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate the caller.

id.description: Source id (ULID). If omitted, a new source is created.

base_url.description: Base URL for the source website or API.

feed_url.description: Feed URL to ingest from (for RSS/API sources).

reliability_score.description: Reliability score in [0,1] used for ranking/trust heuristics.

status.description: Lifecycle status for the source. Only declared transitions are allowed.

tool_schemas.name: upsertContentItem
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new content item or updates an existing one by `id`, including driving moderation lifecycle transitions via `status` and marking deduplication via `duplicate_of_item_id`. Returns the stored content item. Refuses invalid lifecycle transitions, refuses publishing when the source is blocked or the item is marked as a duplicate, and rejects invalid `importance_score` with VALIDATION_ERROR.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate the caller.

id.description: Content item id (ULID). If omitted, a new content item is created.

source_id.description: Source id the item belongs to.

source_item_id.description: Upstream provider's unique identifier for this item, if available.

canonical_url.description: Canonical URL for the item used for deduplication.

body.description: Full body text for long-form content (may be empty for flashes).

published_at.description: Timestamp when the item was originally published by the source.

ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the item was ingested by this backend.

status.description: Moderation status for the item. Only declared transitions are allowed; publishing is refused for duplicates or blocked sources.

duplicate_of_item_id.description: If set, marks this item as a duplicate of another canonical item; duplicates are never served by getNews/getArticles.

importance_score.description: Importance score in [0,1]. Defaults to 0.5 when ingesting if omitted.

tool_schemas.name: createIngestionJob
tool_schemas.description: Queues a new ingestion job for a source. Returns the created ingestion job in `queued` status. Refuses requests for sources that are `disabled` or `blocked`, and refuses unknown job types with VALIDATION_ERROR.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate the caller.

source_id.description: Source to ingest from. Must be an active source.

job_type.description: Type of ingestion run to perform.

scheduled_for.description: Optional time to schedule the job for execution; if omitted, the job is queued immediately.

tool_schemas.name: getCaller
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses missing/invalid credentials with UNAUTHENTICATED.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate the caller.
